title: CATS BLOCKS: HOT SPRINGS
description:
Welcome to Cat Blocks: Hot Springs!

This is a heartwarming, healing hot spring resort built exclusively for our feline friends. In this game, you’ll step into the shoes of a gentle Resort Manager. Alongside your adorable assistant, Orange, you’ll welcome 30 unique block-shaped cats from all walks of life. Your mission? Arrange personalized tatami mats for them across 90 fun-filled levels, each hidden with its own surprises and challenges.

🐾 How to PlayInspired by classic block-matching puzzles and infused with the cozy atmosphere of a cat resort, every level is a "Cat Placement Challenge."

• The Grid: The resort's tatami mats go up to an 8×8 size.

• The Goal: You’ll face cats of various shapes and sizes. Rotate and position them to fit perfectly into the grid without overlapping or going out of bounds.

• The Reward: Once every kitty is tucked in comfortably, you pass the level!

🐱 Game Features• Heartwarming Story: Start your journey with a cute manga-style intro. Orange will guide you through the resort's lore and mechanics, making it easy for anyone to pick up and play.

• 90 Handcrafted Levels: Meet 30 different square-shaped cat guests as the difficulty gradually ramps up. It’s a true test of your spatial logic and patience!

• Collectibles & Power-ups: Discover fun items scattered throughout the levels and use special power-ups to solve tricky puzzles and add an extra layer of strategy to your gameplay.

• Decorate Your Resort: Every successful placement earns warm feedback from your guests. Unlock new decorations to make your hot spring resort even cozier.

🌿 A Healing ExperienceWith its warm color palette, squishy cat designs, and soothing background music, the game creates the perfect atmosphere for relaxation. No complex controls are needed—just tap and drag to enjoy your leisure time.

Come take the reins of Cat Blocks: Hot Springs! Use your wisdom to create the most beloved feline getaway in the world. 🛁🐾
description_short: Welcome to Cat Blocks: Hot Springs ! Your task is to snugly tuck fluffy feline guests into warm rooms and pools. With 90 levels and simple clicks, harvest a full sense of healing.
